snippet.title: Trixibrix on iPhone
snippet.description:
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/trixibrix/id588223530?ls=1&mt=8

Amazing combination of brick breaking and side scrolling gameplay with simple and super responsive controls. Best in class ball physics and beautiful smooth graphics with true motion blur. 

Challenge your friends on the great leader board powered by Game Center. Enjoy the beautifully crafted endless level and incredible long lasting fun. 

Play on your favorite device, Trixibrix supports iPhone 4, iPhone 5, iPad, Retina iPad and iPad mini.
